sentences.sentence: हमर गाममे आमक गाछ पर बहुत रास मञ्जरि आयल अछि।
sentences.romanization: Hamar gam-me aamak gaachh par bahut raas manjari aayal achhi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Palatal aspirates (chh), nasals (m, n), glottal fricative (h).

sentences.sentence: ओना तँ ई काज बड्ड कठिन अछि, मुदा हम सब मिलकें कऽ लेब।
sentences.romanization: Ona ta e kaaj badd kathin achhi, muda hum sab milke ka leb.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Geminate retroflex (dd), retroflex aspirate (th), dental plosive (d).

sentences.sentence: भोरका बेरियाँ सूर्यक किरण सँ चारू दिस इजोत भऽ जाइत छैक।
sentences.romanization: Bhorka beriyaan suryak kiran sa charu dis ijot bha jait chhaik.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Labial aspirate (bh), sibilant (s), palatal affricates (ch, j).

sentences.sentence: किसान खेतमे धानक रोपनी कऽ रहल छथि आ पानि खूब पसि रहल अछि।
sentences.romanization: Kisan khetme dhanak ropani ka rahal chhathi aa pani khoob pasi rahal achhi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Dental aspirate (dh), velar aspirate (kh), palatal aspirate (chh).

sentences.sentence: ठंढाक मौसममे रातिक समय आगिक तर बैसबाक मजा किछ आन होइछ।
sentences.romanization: Thandhak mausam-me raatik samay aagik tar baisabak maja kichh aan hoichh.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Retroflex aspirates (th, dh), sibilants (s), long vowels (aa, o).

sentences.sentence: विद्यालयक प्रांगणमे बच्चा सब खेलि रहल अछि आ मास्टर साहेब पढा रहल छथि।
sentences.romanization: Vidyalayak prangan-me bachcha sab kheli rahal achhi aa master saheb padha rahal chhathi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Geminate palatal (chch), retroflex flap aspirate (dh), velar aspirate (kh).

sentences.sentence: जखन जोर सँ मेघ गर्जैत छैक, तखन मोनमे डर समा जाइत अछि।
sentences.romanization: Jakhan jor sa megh garjait chhaik, takhan mon-me dar sama jait achhi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Velar aspirates (kh, gh), retroflex plosive (d), nasals (m, n).

sentences.sentence: मिथिलाक लोकगीत आ कला-संस्कृति पूरा विश्वमे प्रसिद्ध अछि।
sentences.romanization: Mithilak lokgeet aa kala-sanskriti poora vishwame prasiddh achhi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Dental aspirates (th, ddh), sibilants (s, sh), liquids (l, r).

sentences.sentence: पोखरिक किनारमे बगुला मछरीक ताकमे ठाढ़ अछि।
sentences.romanization: Pokharik kinarm-me bagula machharik taak-me thaadh achhi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Retroflex aspirates (th, dh), velar aspirate (kh), labial plosive (b).

sentences.sentence: छपरा सँ आबि रहल रेलगाड़ी स्टेशन पर समय सँ पहिलें पहुँच गेल।
sentences.romanization: Chhapra sa aabi rahal railgaari station par samay sa pahile pahunch gel.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Retroflex flap (R), palatal aspirates (chh), bilabial plosives (p, b).

sentences.sentence: चुल्हा पर दूध उफनि रहल अछि, जल्दी सँ ओकरा उतारि नीचाँ राखू।
sentences.romanization: Chulha par doodh ufani rahal achhi, jaldi sa okara utaari nichaa raakhoo.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Palatals (ch, chh), dental aspirate (dh), labial fricative (f).

sentences.sentence: गर्मीक दिनमे गाछक छाहरिमे सुतैत काल बड्ड निक निन्न अबैत अछि।
sentences.romanization: Garmik din-me gaachhak chhahari-me sutait kaal badd nik ninn abait achhi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Palatal aspirate (chh), geminate retroflex (dd), nasals (n).

sentences.sentence: हमर गामक बाट बड्ड खराब अछि, बर्खाक समयमे कादो भऽ जाइछ।
sentences.romanization: Hamar gaamak baat badd kharab achhi, barkhak samay-me kaado bha jaichh.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Retroflex (T, dd), velar aspirate (kh), labial aspirate (bh).

sentences.sentence: बौआ, कनेक दोकान सँ चाउर आ दालि कीनि कऽ लऽ आवह।
sentences.romanization: Bauaa, kanek dokaan sa chaur aa daali keeni ka la aavah.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Diphthongs (au), palatal (ch), dentals (d, l).

sentences.sentence: पंडित जी मन्दिरमे पूजा कऽ रहल छथि आ शंखक आवाज चारू कात गुंजि रहल अछि।
sentences.romanization: Pandit ji mandir-me pooja ka rahal chhathi aa shankhak aawaj chaaru kaat gunji rahal achhi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Retroflex (nd), palatal aspirate (chh), velar aspirate (kh).

sentences.sentence: नदीक धार बड्ड तेज अछि, नाव खेबनिहार केँ बहुत धियान राखै पड़ैत छैक।
sentences.romanization: Nadeek dhaar badd tej achhi, naav khebanihaar ke bahut dhiyaan raakhai parait chhaik.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Dental aspirate (dh), geminate (dd), retroflex flap (R), velar aspirate (kh).

sentences.sentence: खेतमे काज करैत-करैत किसानक देह पसीना सँ भीजि गेल अछि।
sentences.romanization: Khet-me kaaj karait-karait kisaanak deh paseena sa bheeji gel achhi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Velar aspirate (kh), labial aspirate (bh), sibilants (s).

sentences.sentence: साँझक समय भेल, आब सब गोटे अपन-अपन घर दिना घुरि रहल छथि।
sentences.romanization: Saanjhak samay bhel, aab sab gote apan-apan ghar dina ghuri rahal chhathi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Nasalized vowels, palatal aspirate (jh, chh), velar aspirate (gh).

sentences.sentence: चौरक रोटि आ तोरीक साग खाइबामे जे स्वाद अछि, से आन कतौ नहि।
sentences.romanization: Chaurak roti aa torik saag khaiba-me je swaad achhi, se aan katau nahi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Palatals (ch), retroflex (T), velar aspirate (kh), labials (b, w).

sentences.sentence: जाड़क महिनामे भोर भोर कुहासा एतेक रहैछ जे किछु नहि सूझैत अछि।
sentences.romanization: Jaarak mahina-me bhor bhor kuhaasa etek rahaichh je kichhu nahi soojhait achhi.
sentences.phonetic_focus: Retroflex flap (R), labial aspirate (bh), palatal aspirates (chh, jh).
